description: A wide handheld game device with a plus-shaped D-pad on its left, joined by a short vertical stalk to a cloud centred above it.
A front-facing oval head with long pointed ears jutting out from both sides, a band across the brow, and a hood or cap whose tip curls over to the right.
The word EPIC in bold, rounded, evenly spaced capital letters on a single horizontal line, with no surrounding shield or frame.
A tall hood with a rounded top and straight sides opening at the bottom into an arched neck gap, with a pair of half-moon eye slits under a heavy scowling brow.
A small front-facing figure with a round head, a triangular dress and two short legs, flanked by large lobed butterfly wings rising on both sides, symmetric about the figure.
A small front-facing figure with a round head, a triangular dress and short legs, with two pairs of long pointed wings sweeping out horizontally from its shoulders, symmetric about the figure.
A winged serpent coiled into a rounded emblem: a large pointed bat-like wing arching over the top, a curved body sweeping around the lower left and a hooked tail tip; the reference is hard to read.
A sauropod dinosaur standing and facing left: a long upright neck ending in a small head with a dot eye, a heavy rounded body on four stubby legs, and a long tail tapering to the right.
A bull-like beast standing and facing left, with a lowered head bearing large forward-curving horns, a massive humped back, thick legs and a short tail at the right; the reference is hard to read.
A front-facing unicorn head, symmetric about its vertical axis: a long face narrowing to a rounded muzzle with a V-shaped mouth line, two dot eyes, two flared ears and a triangular horn at the top.
A standing front-facing person with a round head, a narrow body and straight legs, towering over a tiny house with a pitched roof and door at the lower right, both on one ground line.
A sea monster leaping up and to the left with a gaping open mouth, a dot eye, spiny fins along its back and belly, and a tail curling into a hook at the lower right.
A sea serpent rising in an S-curve from the lower left: a large horned head at the top facing left with wide-open toothed jaws, and a long body curving down beneath it.
